<thought>To locate a template that performs electrophilic aromatic bromination, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that form a halide functional group (bromine) on an aromatic ring. The target product can be represented as bromobenzene (c1ccc(Br)cc1). I will use the search tool with functional_groups_formed set to ["halide"] and limit results to a few entries.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(Br)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
